steps.title: API readiness (/ready)
Officer signs in on the (simulated) duty device
steps.outcome: HTTP 200; refresh token returned to device only

steps.title: Register demonstration device public key
Sync before administrator approval is refused
Administrator approves the device (fingerprint verified out of band)
Start duty session, record location and capture evidence; sync online
Upload evidence bytes; server recomputes SHA-256
Inspect the local manifest and hash
Network disconnected: device records check-in (missed → late), transit, locations, a mock-location fix, evidence and a clock anomaly locally
App/service restart while offline (simulated)
steps.outcome: Queue is held in the persistent outbox; sequence numbers continue (see mobile tests "never resets sequence numbers")

steps.title: Network restored: queued batch synchronised
Duplicate upload of the same batch (e.g. response lost)
Same events re-sent in a new batch
Upload second evidence (periodic pattern)
Deliberately corrupted event payload (coordinates edited after signing)
Forged client hash (recomputed, but old signature)
Corrupted evidence bytes uploaded
Dashboard observation (last known)
Review flags raised for supervisor (prompts, not conclusions)
steps.outcome: CHAIN_LINK_MISMATCH, CHECKIN_LATE, CHECKIN_MISSED, CLOCK_ANOMALY, DEVICE_REGISTRATION, EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH, INVALID_DEVICE_SIGNATURE, MOCK_LOCATION_INDICATOR, SCREEN_RECAPTURE_RISK, SPATIAL_ZONE_EXCEPTION

steps.title: PostGIS spatial-zone checks on synchronised observations
steps.outcome: EVIDENCE_CAPTURED:INSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE | EVIDENCE_CAPTURED:INSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE | LOCATION_OBSERVED:INSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE | LOCATION_OBSERVED:OUTSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE(404.9 m) | EVIDENCE_CAPTURED:INSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE | LOCATION_OBSERVED:INSIDE_ASSIGNED_ZONE

steps.title: Export evidence package and verify it independently (no API/dashboard involved)
Modify ONE bit of the image in a copy of the package and verify again
Generate evidence report PDF
Verify the server audit (chain-of-custody) hash chain
